title: Cloudflare rate-limit rule manifest file
description: One rule per file under the elicited rate-limit-rules-dir. Fields track the Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rules documented shape at https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/rate-limiting-rules/.

id.description: Operator-facing stable rule id (kebab-case; used in drift-audit records as ruleId).

expression.description: Cloudflare WAF rules-language expression string; scopes the rule to a request set.

threshold.description: Requests permitted per period on the characteristic set.

period.description: Window in seconds the threshold applies over.

characteristics.description: Non-empty list of characteristic strings the rule keys on (e.g. cf.colo.id, ip.src, http.host + http.request.uri.path).

action.description: Cloudflare-documented action verb the rule applies over-threshold.

duration.description: Block window in seconds the (N+1)th and subsequent requests are refused for.

description.description: Optional operator-facing description of the rule intent.
